title: fix(app-shell): the header draws its Search trigger only where a command palette is mounted (objectui#11912)
body:
Fixes #11912

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The console header drew its "Search ⌘K" trigger in every frame, but only `ConsoleLayout` mounts a `CommandPaletteProvider` (and only `AppContent` mounts the palette). On `/home`, `/ai`, `/organizations` and an organization's own pages, `useCommandPalette()` answered its documented no-op fallback, so a click opened nothing and `Ctrl+K` opened nothing either.

This takes the card's second route: the header does not show the trigger where no palette is mounted. A search that works with no active app is objectui#11863's question and is not touched here.

- `packages/app-shell/src/context/CommandPaletteProvider.tsx` — a new `useCommandPaletteProviderMounted()` answers whether a provider is mounted above the caller. It is package-internal: not re-exported from `context/index.ts` or the package entry. `useCommandPalette()` keeps its published return shape (`CommandPaletteContextValue`) and its no-op fallback; only its docblock changed, because it said the header trigger "is then inert".
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx` — the search group (desktop `action:command-palette:open` and compact `action:command-palette:open-mobile`) renders only when that hook answers `true`. The group is dropped whole, so no empty `data-topbar-group` is left behind. Inside an app nothing changes.
- `.changeset/11912-inert-search-trigger.md` — `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`.

The gate is the provider's presence, not the variant name. If a palette is later mounted outside apps (objectui#11863), the trigger comes back there without touching the header again.

## Pins

- New `AppHeader.searchTriggerNeedsPalette-11912.test.tsx` (real `AppHeader`, real `CommandPaletteProvider`, real `MemoryRouter`):
  - with no provider, the `home`, `orgs` and `app` variants draw neither trigger testid and no `aria-keyshortcuts` element, while the header itself drew (the inbox bell is there);
  - CONTROL: under the provider, the `app` and `home` variants draw both triggers, and a click on each one opens the palette (`useCommandPalette().open` goes `false` to `true`, the URL gains `palette=1`).
- `AppHeader.designInStudioNeedsAuthoring-10899.test.tsx` used the desktop trigger as its "the header rendered" check while mounting the `app` variant with no provider. Its mount now sits under `CommandPaletteProvider`, which is how `ConsoleLayout` mounts that variant. No assertion changed.

## Reverse verification (ablation)

Run from the committed head `3664e20c` with `ablation-replace` (anchor must hit; write, restore and blob checked on disk). The hook's body `return useContext(CommandPaletteContext) !== null;` was replaced by `return true;`:

- anchor 1 to 0, blob `3e03354a65fc` to `d9f466451f93`;
- the new file: `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`. The three no-provider cases (`home`, `orgs`, `app`) went red with "expected document not to contain element, found BUTTON"; the two provider controls stayed green;
- restored: blob equal to HEAD (`3e03354a65fc`), `git diff HEAD` empty.

The subject is imported from `src` by relative path, so no `dist` rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.

## Browser check

Chromium at 1440x900 and 800x900. The console was served by `vite` from this branch, and from `main` `989b1908` as the control, both against a scratch `objectstack dev` backend (17.7.0, one app `probe_search_app`), signed in as the seeded admin.

| Frame | `main` 989b1908 | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| `/home` | trigger shown; click: URL stays `/home`, 0 overlays; `Ctrl+K`: 0 overlays | no trigger, no `aria-keyshortcuts`; `Ctrl+K`: 0 overlays |
| `/organizations?create=1` (`OrganizationsLayout`) | trigger shown; click: 0 overlays; `Ctrl+K`: 0 | no trigger; `Ctrl+K`: 0 |
| `/organizations/default/members` (`OrganizationLayout`) | trigger shown; click: 0 overlays; `Ctrl+K`: 0 | no trigger; `Ctrl+K`: 0 |
| `/apps/probe_search_app/psrch_task` | trigger shown; click and `Ctrl+K` open the palette (`?palette=1`, 1 overlay) | same: click and `Ctrl+K` open the palette (`?palette=1`, 1 overlay) |

The same at 800 px, where the compact trigger is the visible one. On every frame without a trigger the header keeps two `data-topbar-group` blocks (inbox and help, account), none empty, and the first one has no left divider (border 0px, margin 0px). No page errors.

`/ai` is NOT MEASURED in the browser: this backend serves no AI, so the route guard sends `/ai` to `/home`. `AiChatPage` mounts the same `home` variant with no provider, which the unit pin covers.

## Gates (run from the worktree root)

All on head `3664e20c` (the last commit; nothing was committed after these runs).

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/` (whole package, `--maxWorkers=2`, under the shared verify lock): exit 0, `Test Files  1187 passed | 1 skipped (1188)`, `Tests  11476 passed | 9 skipped (11485)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` on the two touched AppHeader test files: exit 0, `Test Files  2 passed (2)`, `Tests  8 passed (8)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the test project's file list includes both touched test files): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build`: exit 0, `dist completeness: 1 package(s) complete`. Built entry check: `dist/index.d.ts` re-exports `useCommandPalette` (control) and has no `export *`; `useCommandPaletteProviderMounted` appears only in `dist/context/CommandPaletteProvider.d.ts`, which the entry reaches only through named re-exports. The package entry's type graph does not change.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the four touched source files: exit 0, 0 errors (warnings only, all of a kind the files already carried).
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:unreferenced-sources`: all exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, 1 changeset declared for 4 changed source files of 1 released package. `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `check:readme-exports` (it needs every package built and refuses on unbuilt `plugin-*` entries; this PR changes no export), and `Bundle Analysis` / `check:eager-closure` (CI). The change adds no import and no first-load module.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/app-shell/README.md` ("Command palette (⌘K)") is not edited. It is off this card's file surface, and no sentence in it became false: it names the trigger's testids and does not say where the trigger renders.
- `ConsoleLayout` is a published export that mounts the provider but not the palette (`AppContent` mounts `CommandPalette`). A host that uses `ConsoleLayout` without `CommandPalette` still gets a trigger that sets `?palette=1` and opens nothing. That is a read-only inference with no named producer, so it is noted here and not filed.
- The `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning on the new hook is the same warning `useCommandPalette()` already carries in that file. ESLint reports 0 errors on the four touched files.

This was implemented by the os-dev seat for objectui#11912, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`.
